findings.title: Commit markers are checkboxes and occur too frequently
findings.description: The `Commit:` entries are checkbox items rather than plain `**Commit**:` lines, and markers appear after most tasks, including documentation and fixture-only tasks. Consolidate them at a smaller number of working, tested milestones.

findings.title: TypeScript memory failures have conflicting outcomes
findings.description: Task 10 treats exceptions listed in `token_errors` as per-file failures but requires `MemoryError` to fail the entire duplication measurement. Task 14 includes `MemoryError` in TypeScript’s `token_errors`, so a junior implementer could reasonably catch it as a per-file error and return a partial result. Remove it from that list or explicitly give whole-pass handling precedence, and test the TypeScript path.

findings.title: Duplication tasks do not explicitly exclude blank lines
findings.description: D3 requires `per_file` to count duplicated **non-blank** lines. Task 10 instead says to mark every line under the windows, and the tests do not assert that blank lines within a duplicated block are excluded. Clarify the count and add that assertion to the existing duplication test.

findings.title: Repeated-token test conflicts with the non-overlap rule
findings.description: The test says a run of one repeated token does not count, but a sufficiently long run contains non-overlapping 100-token windows, which D3 permits as copies. Specify a run shorter than 200 tokens for the overlap-only case, or distinguish overlapping from non-overlapping occurrences in the assertion.
